Essentials
Flights

Out, British Airways: BA0186 Austin (AUS) Monday September 21 at 10:30 PM to Heathrow (LHR) Terminal 5, lands 1:55 PM September 22, Club World. Connect at Terminal 5, about 5 hours. BA0522 Heathrow 7:05 PM to Florence Peretola (FLR), lands 10:20 PM, Club Europe. Two checked bags at 32 kg each on both legs. Arno Travel’s transfer meets you outside baggage claim with an ECCELLENZE sign and takes you to Borgo Pignano Florence. Home, United KYMT99: UA967 Naples (NAP) Friday October 16 at 2:00 PM to Newark (EWR) 6:20 PM, then UA1409 Newark 8:40 PM to Austin (AUS) 11:43 PM. Economy, seats 36F and 15D, $2,260.23, fully refundable. Watching for award space; cancel KYMT99 if an award opens.

Rental car

Avis #26405920US2. Fiat 600, automatic, unlimited km. Pick up Florence Vespucci (FLR) Friday September 25 at 9:00 AM. Drop Rome Fiumicino (FCO) Saturday October 10 at 12:00 PM. $1,358.61 prepaid. No car from October 10 onward; Arno Travel asked to help with transfers for the Amalfi leg.

Why this trip

Italy collection for Suites With Keith / Fora, releasing print and digital February / March 2027. Eccellenze hosts the first two Florence nights. Everything after is site inspections, shoots and hosted or paid stays.

Drive times

Tuscany to Portofino about 3 hours. Portofino to Cernobbio about 2 hours 45. Como to the Dolomites about 3 hours. Alpe di Siusi to Montalcino about 4 hours 30, the longest day. Val d’Orcia to Rome about 2 hours 30. Rome to Positano about 3 hours.
